title: Smart Collar Health MCP v0.2.0 contract
description: Normative domain, MCP tool, webhook, and golden-message contract for the smart-neckband repository.

analyzed_through_ecg_sample_index.description: PC-expanded monotonic ECG sample ordinal within analysis_source_instance_id; not the raw uint32 wire index.

ecg_sample_index.description: PC-expanded monotonic ECG sample ordinal within source_instance_id; not the raw uint32 wire index.

device_reset_detection.pending_window_scope: Every CRC-valid device-to-PC V0 packet accepted by PacketParser, currently ECG_BATCH, IMU_BATCH, DEVICE_STATUS, VOICE_TEXT_CHUNK, and VOICE_STATUS. Future inbound packet types enter this scope by default.
device_reset_detection.voice_text_retransmission_wire_semantics: Commit 17fc0df reuses utterance_id/text but allocates a new global V0 packet_sequence and current timestamp_us for every send/retransmission. RETRANSMIT payload flags do not affect reset eligibility.
device_reset_detection.future_packet_type_rule: Every new device-to-PC packet type is buffered and trigger-eligible by default. Exclusion requires a wire-level old-header retransmission rule plus a documented reset-detection completeness proof.
device_reset_detection.while_pending: Buffer every accepted inbound V0 packet in receive order, including voice packets, and do not publish state, events, webhooks, or voice ACKs. Never buffer the outbound VOICE_TEXT_ACK and do not create another candidate.
device_reset_detection.confirmed_policy: Rotate source_instance_id exactly once, clear per-source health rings, analysis windows, trigger maxima, and loss baselines, preserve lifetime diagnostics and durably committed voice text, then replay the full buffer in receive order into the new instance through each subsystem's normal deduplication.
device_reset_detection.unconfirmed_policy: Do not rotate. Drop the trigger candidate, then revalidate and replay every other buffered packet in receive order against the old instance as if the candidate never existed; drop and count any packet that still fails.
device_reset_detection.rotation_completion_rule: Clear the global pending window before another candidate can be created.
required_interleaving_tests: ECG trigger with interleaved IMU_BATCH and DEVICE_STATUS
ECG trigger with interleaved VOICE_TEXT_CHUNK and VOICE_STATUS
same utterance retransmission with new forward sequence/timestamp does not falsely trigger reset
two VOICE_TEXT_CHUNK packets after a real sequence/timestamp rollback can trigger and confirm reset
confirmed reset replays voice chunks through utterance/chunk deduplication without early ACK

ecg_sample_index_semantics.public_meaning: PC-expanded monotonically increasing ECG sample ordinal within one source_instance_id
ecg_sample_index_semantics.extender_location: One shared extender after SourceInstanceCoordinator commit and before serial/BLE runtime, ECG ring, analysis, or state updates.

freshness_policy.wearer_state_evidence: last accepted ECG_BATCH containing at least one ECG sample
freshness_policy.transport_liveness_scope: any accepted device-to-PC V0 packet; outbound VOICE_TEXT_ACK excluded
freshness_policy.never_received_ecg_behavior: Do not create WearerState; health.get_device_status may still report transport state.
required_non_ecg_continuity_tests: IMU, device status, and voice packets continue while ECG stops for more than 2000 ms: health freshness becomes stale and input_stale opens
IMU, device status, and voice packets continue while ECG stops for more than 10000 ms: health freshness becomes offline and input_offline opens

order: optional raw recorder or raw_chunk_callback writes each received transport chunk byte-for-byte exactly once
create immutable StagedPacket with one monotonic/UTC PacketReceipt
extend committed ECG raw uint32 sample indices through the one per-source ordinal extender
append ECG/IMU/status ring or enter voice assembler
publish, durable voice insert, and voice ACK

device_status_policy.offline: reader closed/error; transport age >10000 ms; or no inbound packet for >10000 ms after reader start
device_status_policy.stale: reader normal and transport age in (2000,10000] ms
device_status_policy.degraded: within initial 10000 ms without a packet; or transport fresh but ECG missing/older than 2000 ms or another device degradation exists
device_status_policy.ok: transport and ECG both fresh with no degradation evidence

runtime_invariants: WearerState.device.last_transport_packet_age_ms is non-null because every accepted ECG packet is also an inbound transport packet.
For get_current_state success, ToolMeta.age_ms equals WearerState.age_ms.
A valid heart metric belongs to WearerState.source_instance_id and is analyzed through a PC-expanded ECG ordinal not newer than WearerState.ecg_sample_index.
Serial/BLE runtime, ECG ring, EcgAnalysisResult, and WearerState use the same post-commit ECG ordinal extender; raw uint32 fields are diagnostic only.
Non-ECG inbound packets never refresh ECG evidence age.

health.get_device_status.age_ms: device.last_transport_packet_age_ms, or null before any inbound packet

health.get_recent_events.data_source: the common data source when a non-empty page contains one source; otherwise null

DEVICE_OFFLINE.data_source: device snapshot data source when available, otherwise null
DEVICE_OFFLINE.age_ms: transport age when available, otherwise null

pre_first_wearer_state.policy: No Health event transition, event ID, state_revision reference, or webhook outbox may be created before the first persisted WearerState.
pre_first_wearer_state.status_evidence: Fresh DEVICE_STATUS evidence may remain in memory/status ring and health.get_device_status remains available.
pre_first_wearer_state.first_state_rule: When the first ECG creates WearerState revision R, reevaluate retained still-fresh status evidence in the same transaction; an observed lead-off opens with state_revision R.
pre_first_wearer_state.required_test: Only status/voice packets arrive, no ECG has ever arrived, and lead_off is true: no event/outbox. First ECG then opens lead_off against the first state revision.

operation_order: persist offline WearerState as revision R
resolve input_stale with event_revision + 1 and state_revision R
open input_offline with event_revision 1 and state_revision R
enqueue input_stale resolved notification as sequence N
enqueue input_offline opened notification as sequence N + 1
input_stale_to_input_offline.dispatch_rule: Per wearer, sequence N + 1 is blocked until N is acknowledged or moved to dead letter.

body_serialization.retry_rule: Persist the first raw body bytes and reuse them byte-for-byte; only the signature timestamp header changes.

secret_configuration.encoding: lowercase hexadecimal without prefix or whitespace
secret_configuration.invalid_configuration_action: Fail closed before starting sender/receiver workers and before any network request; log only variable name and error category.

advisory_request_headers.Accept: Sender should send application/json; receiver must not require or validate it and response format does not negotiate through this header.
advisory_request_headers.User-Agent: Sender should identify smart-neckband-health; receiver must not require or validate it.

redirect_policy.reason: Never forward signed headers or raw health notification bodies to an endpoint that did not pass the configured URL policy.

receiver_idempotency.transaction: Atomic insert-or-read-digest under a database unique constraint; queue insertion occurs in the same transaction only for the winning insert.
receiver_idempotency.same_id_same_digest_concurrency: Exactly one accepted, every other request duplicate, exactly one queue row.
receiver_idempotency.same_id_different_digest_concurrency: Exactly one value accepted; every losing different digest returns 409 notification_id_conflict.
receiver_idempotency.crash_after_commit_before_ack: Retry returns duplicate without another queue row.
